title: Camera firmware versions MV 6.2.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Fri, 24 Jan 2025

Bug fixes: Resolved an issue affecting cameras using Motion-based Retention on MV6.2, ensuring retention policies are correctly enforced
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 devices will run MV4.15
